entries.title: Thirteen new animations for the Spideryarn logo
entries.body: The Spideryarn logo has thirteen new animations, for the spider and for the letters. They play when you point at or tap the logo, and twelve also play while an article loads. The spider playing dead is kept off the loading page, where it could look like an error.

entries.title: Author gift emails always link the right article
entries.body: When we send an author their piece as a gift, the link in the email always opens the article the gift was written for; if the address leads to a different article, the gift is not sent. A private link to the article is made only at sending, once we have confirmed we may share it.
